turn: The notice parser now skips any notice whose form type isn't one we recognize. I added an `is_supported` check in `src/parse/forms.py` that accepts CN, CAN, PIN and CORR, and logs a warning with the notice id and form value for anything else before returning False. That way unfamiliar forms no longer reach the rest of the parsing and fail partway through. I checked it by running it on sample notices: each of the four known forms passed, and an unknown form and a notice with no form attribute were both skipped with the expected warning. While I was in the same area I also fixed a small unrelated bug. The warning message could print `None` for the notice id when the id element had surrounding whitespace, so I made it strip that whitespace. Next I'll start on "Normalize buyer names".

sidefix.title: Strip whitespace from logged notice id
sidefix.what: The skip warning could show a blank or None notice id when the id element had surrounding whitespace, so the id is now stripped before logging.
